title: 5. hdrctl vs hdrctl workflow: two namespaces, two things
description: Scaffold a single job and a full workflow project side by side, then see why hdrctl list and hdrctl workflow list each find only one of them — and run the workflow end to end. In about 8 minutes.

steps.title: Scaffold a job and a workflow
hdrctl list only sees the job
hdrctl workflow list only sees the workflow
